name: Charts
description: Brand-configurable SVG bar, pie/donut, line, scatter and bubble charts. One copy includes the shared brand specification, deterministic styling, accessible data tables and optional CSS entrance animation.
whenToUse: Comparisons, part-to-whole data, trends and numeric relationships that must follow a saved brand's chart rules. Copy Charts.tsx once and configure a shared ChartBrand; use BarChart, PieChart, LineChart, ScatterChart or BubbleChart from sections. Start from skeleton.charts.tsx. Supply stable series/observation IDs, a surface name, semantic roles and any highlighted series IDs; styling belongs in the brand specification. Supports grouped/stacked and horizontal bars, pie/donut, missing line values, continuous numeric scatter axes, optional per-series linear fits, area-proportional bubbles with solid or concentric-ring treatments, responsive container layouts, compact numeric axes, right/bottom legends, independent pie category/value labels, background restrictions and optional animation without hydration. Dense data can scroll deliberately. NOT a general plotting library, real-time interaction engine, packed-bubble layout or infographic illustration tool. Font assets are loaded by the consuming design system.
